name: Contra Coffee & Tea
tagline: Craft coffees and teas on tap, 100% dairy-free, in a historic literary arts hub
description: An innovative, dairy-free craft beverage bar serving nitro cold brews, artisanal teas, and house-crafted seasonal concoctions on tap like a craft brewery. Located within the historic 1888 Center building alongside a boutique bookshop and Resident Vinyl record store, Contra is an Old Towne creative sanctuary loved for its signature tasting flights, Vietnamese iced coffees (Gold Rush), and adventurous seasonal taps.
historicNote: Housed within the historic 1888 Center building, an intimate turn-of-the-century structure dedicated to California literary arts, creative writers, and vinyl music culture.

specials.title: Monday Tap Kickoff: $1 Off Nitro Cold Brews
specials.description: Kickstart your week with $1 off any signature nitro cold brew on tap (including the Gold Rush Vietnamese iced coffee).

specials.title: Tasting Flight Tuesday
specials.description: Build your own 4-tap tasting flight (sample nitro cold brews, seasonal lattes, Thai tea, or Matchas Foster) for $12.

specials.title: Matcha & Tea Midweek Refresh
specials.description: Special $6 pour on all specialty matcha and shaken tea lattes including the Matchas Foster and Orange St. Chai.

specials.title: Study & Vinyl Happy Hour
specials.description: 15% off all tap drinks for Chapman students and locals with book or record purchase at Resident Vinyl.

specials.title: Friday R+D Seasonal Showcase
specials.description: First taste of weekly rotating Research & Development pilot tap drinks and limited seasonal batches (like Banoffee or KC Tonic).

specials.title: Weekend Autumn Nitro Feature
specials.description: Featured pours of Welcome Great Pumpkin (PSL with housemade pumpkin cream) and Patagonia (pumpkin Thai tea).

specials.title: Sunday Slow Sip & Growler Refills
specials.description: 20% off all 32oz growler fills of dairy-free cold brew or tea on tap to stock up for the week.

events.title: 1888 Center Acoustic & Poetry Night
events.description: Intimate live acoustic and spoken word performances in the shared gallery space with draft coffee and tea specials.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Researched and verified 115 N Orange St location, hours (Mon-Sat 8am-8pm, Sun 9am-7pm), phone (714) 696-8793, 100% dairy-free tap model, and October 2026 seasonal specials (Welcome Great Pumpkin, Patagonia, Matchas Foster, Banoffee).
